nuSIM.label: nuSIM
nuSIM.description: This device management object represents a nuSIM integrated SIM according to NTS.01 - nuSIM Integrated SIM Specification.

EID.label: EID
EID.description: Contains the unique identifier of the nuSIM.

ICCID.label: ICCID
ICCID.description: Contains the ICCID of the currently loaded nuSIM profile.

nuSIM_Capabilities.label: nuSIM Capabilities
nuSIM_Capabilities.description: Contains the supported nuSIM specification version and optional capabilities of the nuSIM.

nuSIM_Cert.label: nuSIM Cert
nuSIM_Cert.description: Contains the individual nuSIM certificate CERT.NUSIM.ECDSA, if available.

nuSIM_Profile.label: nuSIM Profile
nuSIM_Profile.description: Points to an instance of the nuSIM profile object which is to be loaded by executing Load Profile, see Resource 5.

Load_Profile_Result.label: Load Profile Result
Load_Profile_Result.description: Contains the result of the last Load Profile operation: 0=successful, 1=not successful, other values are implementation-specific.

Load_Profile.label: Load Profile
Load_Profile.description: Loads the profile instance referenced in Resource 4 to nuSIM.
